description: A modular, API-first application for identifying and clustering duplicate or similar media files (images), using name, size, and metadata matching with weighting and scoring. Includes CLI tools and future UI integration.

core_modules: scanner.py – Crawls filesystem for media files
matcher.py – Computes weighted similarity between media files
indexer.py – Orchestrates scanning, matching, and clustering
support_modules: utils.py – Path cleaning, summarization, JSON safety
load_test_env.py – Environment config loader for test scaffolding
api_modules: match.py – (planned) Match preview or deduplication APIs
file_record.py – Pydantic model for file metadata
testing: test_indexer.py – CLI test tool for match detection

key_features: Weighted scoring for similarity based on name, size, and time
Support for exact and fuzzy (1s window) timestamp match
Cluster summaries and JSON output to raw and sorted formats
Configurable via .env templates for different input folders
priorities: Add reason metadata to each cluster (done)
Output pretty summary only, suppress verbose logs (done)
Enable file path rel from root (done)
Add optional BDD tests for full CLI and API (in progress)
Prepare UI flow for human-in-the-loop review (future)
next_steps: Tune scoring thresholds for more precise grouping
Expose scoring model via API for experimentation
Support clustering by camera metadata (lens/model) or visual hash
Wire deduplication logic for automated or manual decision-making
Enable export to training data for LLM or image classifier
note: All assistant context is token-local only; shared memory only stores that project is active with modular structure.
